column1: # Settings registry: the single source (awto/include/settings.h). Generated from it by awto-ddc scripts/settings_gen.py:
# set_table, OSD menu pages (with settings/pages.tsv), DDC/CI VCP map, NVRAM record + schema, host table, docs/settings.md.
# - id: stable, never reused (NVRAM key, VCP paged id, docs anchor). 1..255 (the NVRAM record keys are one byte).
# - type: bool | enum | int | action. unit: none percent ms s step hz dhz (0.1 Hz).
# - flags: nv (saved), live (applied on every change, else on confirm), risky (can blank or cut access: auto-revert
#   unless confirmed), reboot (takes effect after a restart), ro (status, read from the firmware), inert (stored only:
#   the firmware has no reader yet: vendor menu items not built, and our rows whose owner is still to wire it),
# - nv_slot: auto = position in the NVRAM record (id-tagged, so slots may move). vcp: MCCS code or '-';
#   every row is also reachable through the manufacturer paged pair 0xE0 (id) / 0xE1 (value).
# - apply: set_ap_<apply>(id, value) pushes it to the firmware; '-' = the owner reads the value when it needs it.
# - options: enum labels, '|' separated; label=N gives the VCP value of that option (default: the option index).
# - provenance: [vendor-ui] = item, range and default of the vendor (SDK demo) menu, walked in the sim (#65, #67).
